_source: Mirrored by hand from apps/web/app/globals.css (token layer) and apps/web/lib/site.ts (business facts). globals.css remains the single source of truth — if a token changes there, change it here.

org.name: Uno Digit
org._url_note: www is mandatory — the apex unodigit.com.au has no DNS record and does not connect (verified 2026-08-22). apps/web/lib/site.ts was corrected to www on 2026-08-22, so the site and this file now agree.

type.note: Uno Sans carries size-adjust: 93.02% on the web. Print artwork does NOT apply it — there is no SF Pro to metric-match against on a banner, and shrinking the face 7% costs stature at 2 metres. Web tracking values are therefore re-tuned per print role rather than reused.
